name: Haiku growth at a reasonable price
strategy: AI infrastructure alpha with capital preservation: concentrated positions in highest-quality AI ecosystem companies, reduced semiconductor cyclical exposure, elevated cash for post-FOMC deployment
reassessment_note: Rate hike expectations (88% probability) and AI safety concerns (Sept 14 sell-off) create near-term headwinds for growth and semiconductor cycles. Trimming most exposed commodity semiconductor positions (AVGO, LRCX) while maintaining core AI infrastructure thesis through quality companies (MSFT, NVDA, CRM) that will drive long-term AI buildout regardless of near-term volatility. Increasing cash from 20% to 36% preserves capital and enables opportunistic redeployment post-FOMC if markets correct further. This approach balances the mandate's quality-over-momentum philosophy with prudent capital preservation.

positions.thesis: Microsoft is the highest-quality AI infrastructure play with entrenched cloud position (Azure), proven ability to monetize AI (CoPilot adoption, Enterprise AI), and strong competitive moat. Despite near-term rate pressure, MSFT's business quality and secular AI tailwinds justify full-weight position as portfolio anchor.

Nvidia remains essential to AI infrastructure but faces cyclical semiconductor pressure and AI safety concerns. Reducing from 14% to 10% locks in +3.14% gains while maintaining core exposure to GPU dominance. The company's quality and indispensability to AI training justify keeping as significant position despite near-term volatility.

Salesforce shows strong momentum (+49.33% this leg), demonstrating successful AI platform monetization (Einstein). Position well-insulated from semiconductor cycle concerns, benefits from enterprise AI spending regardless of rate environment. Maintain full weight given quality and performance.

Visa provides non-cyclical, non-tech diversification within quality portfolio. Transparent, high-quality business with pricing power that should weather rate hikes. Maintain as defensive quality holding.

Johnson & Johnson offers defensive quality positioning in healthcare, less exposed to rate hike and AI safety concerns. Maintains portfolio diversification while demonstrating 'quality over momentum' discipline.

Adobe benefits from AI-driven workflow automation (Generative Fill, Content Accelerator) while maintaining a cash-generative subscription business. +10.72% performance confirms quality of positioning in creative AI applications.
Berkshire Hathaway provides ultimate quality and defensiveness, with cash fortress to deploy in corrections. Non-correlated asset that provides portfolio insurance during tech volatility.

AMD is critical to AI infrastructure but faces near-term semiconductor cycle pressure. Reducing from 6% to 4% trims cyclical exposure while maintaining participation in GPU/AI chip secular trend. Quality company but commoditized relative to NVDA.

Broadcom is exposed to AI semiconductor capex cycle but has been hit hard (-7.83% this leg) by safety concerns and rate hike expectations. Reducing from 9% to 4% limits exposure to cyclical semiconductor downturn while maintaining some upside to AI infrastructure buildout.

Lam Research (semiconductor equipment) is most cyclical and most exposed to potential AI buildout slowdown. Trimming from 7% to 2% (token position) eliminates meaningful cyclical headwind while maintaining mandate participation. Will redeploy if semiconductor weakness proves temporary.

Bitcoin (1% weight) provides asymmetric optionality on technology adoption and serves as hedge against extended rate hike cycle. Minimal position size limits downside risk while maintaining exposure to alternative store of value narrative.
